facts.text: What is the total retail purchase price (MSRP) of a new entry-level Apple iPad Pro M4 in USD? Do not use monthly financing. How much would it cost in Swiss Franc (CHF) if the exchange rate is 0.88 CHF for 1 USD?

Action: duckduck
